author: kirito_kx9
quote: GTA 6 gets a 99 on Metacritic, because apparently Rockstar could sell critics a $100 loading screen and they'd call it the second coming of gaming. Thirteen years of hype, billions in marketing, and suddenly every reviewer has discovered their inner Shakespeare. Is it genuinely a masterpiece? Maybe. But when a game arrives carrying this much hype, money and industry prestige, you'd think critics were reviewing a religious experience rather than a video game. At this point, giving GTA 6 anything less than a 10 probably requires witness protection.
